name: Chibi Visitor v4
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modelling
creation_method: Blender 5.1.2, built through the Blender MCP server (Blender Lab extension 1.0.3). The skull relief was worked with Blender sculpt brushes (sculpt_head.py, interactive only; baked to sources/head-sculpt.json); ears, nose, neck, hair, clothing and accessories are procedural Python in generate.py. No image-to-3D service, downloaded mesh, add-on asset or downloaded texture is used. The supplied character sheet is a design reference and is not embedded.

geometry.origin: between the feet on the ground

accuracy_notes: Stylised interpretation of the owner's v4.0 sheet. Head: shallow sculpted relief (mean 1.25 mm from the parametric skull), fused ears/nose/neck, painted face texture. Hair: fused cap and fringe plus 17 broad shingled back locks with baked ambient-occlusion vertex colours (COLOR_0 on Hair), one thin ahoge, thin wing flicks. Hands are fused fists. Body and shoes are simplified procedural parts. Head silhouette rows (z >= 0.60 m) within a mean of 6-7 px (about 1 cm) of the sheet. Quality gate run 002: validator 0/0/0/0, headless rebuild byte-identical, Three.js load clean. Status REWORK: three independent visual reviews still rank the hair surface (scale-like rear, conical flicks, thin ahoge) and the dark ear-front wedge as P1. Not rigged, not in the catalog; frame time and device performance not measured for this build.
rights: Original asset; owner-project reuse is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
